calibration.method: One crown-to-middle-cloak-tip calibration on Six-Hand Rend ready; no arm-height fit and no per-frame/per-strip pose fit.
calibration.note: Calibration retained ONCE from R3 ready before whole-strip spacing revisions R4/R5; original R3 retained. No per-pose/strip scale fit.

scale_policy: Calibrate once from Six-Hand Rend ready. Original canvas width/N converts raster resolution only; no per-frame or per-strip anatomical fit.
raw_policy: raw/original is byte-exact generator output incl rejected versions. raw/<move> is DERIVED: clear alpha<=8 and hidden RGB, crop alpha bbox and pad >=64px; no redraw/rescale. Original and padded bboxes/gaps separate.
anchor_policy: No feet: actual cleaned-alpha lowest cloak endpoint maps to896; alpha bbox <=899. Down uses pooled cloth contact. All actual hover offsets0; torso/cloth articulation preserves original pose.
